Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Add Path.walk_controlled(*,follow_symlinks=False,max_depth=None,exclude=(),stable=False,errors="strict"). Yield Path descendants in depth-first preorder, root depth=0; exclude relative POSIX fnmatch patterns before yielding or descending, optionally sort names per directory. Default yields links without following directory links; opted-in following tracks directory (device,inode) identities to prevent cycles/repeated subtree traversal. Respect original error handler resolution and caller Path subclass; close scandir handles, validate policies, preserve legacy walk and do not follow links implicitly.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_pa_walk_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-pa-walk-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

Add Path.relative_beneath(base), normalizing absolute lexical paths then requiring commonpath containment and returning relative Path of the caller class. Same path returns "."; sibling prefix collisions and normalized .. escapes reject with ValueError, including cross-drive errors from the path module. Do no filesystem reads, symlink resolution or existence checks. Preserve original relpath and clearly distinguish this lexical operation from a symlink-safe containment/security boundary.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_pa_beneath_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-pa-beneath-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

Add Path.read_hashes(algorithms,*,chunk_size=8192,hex=True), returning insertion-ordered algorithm->digest mapping. Materialize/deduplicate algorithm names, validate fixed-size hash objects and positive integer chunk size before opening, read one stream once and update every digest for each bounded chunk. Add Path.iter_lines(encoding=None,errors="strict",*,retain=True,newline=None), a lazy text iterator owning one context-managed stream. None uses universal newline normalization; "" retains original CR/LF/CRLF terminators; retain=False removes exactly the physical line ending. Preserve blank lines, Unicode, missing final newline and codec error policy. Early generator.close and decode/I/O exceptions must close the stream, with no whole-file read or changes to existing lines/read_text behavior.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_pa_iter_lines_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-pa-iter-lines-dev.md. Add Path.atomic_write(content,*,encoding="utf-8",if_changed=False). Validate and encode str/bytes before creating a same-directory temp, flush/fsync, retain old mode or use 0600 when new, replace atomically and clean failure paths. Reject symlinks; if_changed=True preserves inode/mtime/mode when bytes match and returns False, otherwise True. Serialization/replace failures preserve old bytes. Keep ordinary write methods unchanged and do not promise concurrent compare-and-swap or directory-fsync crash guarantees.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_pa_atomic_write_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-pa-atomic-write-dev.md.
